requirements_summary.summary: Participium is a web application for the Municipality of Turin enabling citizens to report urban issues (e.g., potholes, trash) via an interactive map or Telegram bot. Reports undergo a lifecycle: Pending Approval -> Assigned (to Technical Office) -> In Progress -> Resolved/Rejected/Suspended. The system supports external maintainers (with or without platform access), internal communication channels, notifications (email/push), and detailed statistics for administrators.

requirements.text:
As an unregistered user
I want to see approved reports on an interactive map 
So that I can know about issues in my area and beyond.
expected_behaviors: I can know about issues in my area and beyond

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member
I want to assign reports to external maintainers
So that specialized maintainers can handle and update the intervention.
constraints: It can be possible for specific reports of certain categories (e.g., Enel X for category Public Lighting) based on their content reviewed by the technical office staff member.
expected_behaviors: specialized maintainers can handle and update the intervention

requirements.text:
As an external maintainer 
I want to update the status of a report assigned to me
So that I can updated citizens about  the intervention.
expected_behaviors: I can updated citizens about  the intervention

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member/external maintainer
I want to exchange information and comments on the report internally
So that coordination happens without exposing internal notes to citizens
expected_behaviors: coordination happens without exposing internal notes to citizens

requirements.text:
As a citizen
I want to register with my name and username 
So that I can access the Participium system and submit reports.
constraints: Registration is required before submitting reports.
expected_behaviors: I can access the Participium system and submit reports

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to confirm my registration with a code
So that my account becomes valid and I can start using the system.
constraints: Once a registration is completed, the user gets an email with a confirmation code. The person can use the application only after confirming by entering the code valid for 30 minutes.
expected_behaviors: my account becomes valid and I can start using the system

requirements.text:
As a system administrator
I want to set up municipality users
constraints: These are the internal accounts of the municipality

requirements.text:
As a system administrator
I want to assign roles to municipality users
constraints: Possible roles: municipal public relations officer, municipal administrator, technical office staff member, external maintainer. You can be more specific on technical offices to run realisti scenarios following the official organizational structure of the municipality of Turin (https://trasparenza.comune.torino.it/media/2212/download)

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to provide details for my report 
So that the the problem is classified correctly.
constraints: Mandatory fields: title, description,  category , photos (min 1 max 3).
expected_behaviors: the the problem is classified correctly

requirements.text:
As a municipal public relations officer
I want to review and approve or reject reports 
So that only valid reports are processed further.
constraints: Rejected reports must include an explanation. If accepted, the report is assigned to the technical office bound to the report category.
expected_behaviors: only valid reports are processed further

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to see approved reports on an interactive map 
So that I can know about issues in my area and beyond.
constraints: Map should be zoomable. When zooming out, reports can be grouped into a cumulative report for a better visualization (total number should be reported on the cumulative report). When zooming in,  reports can be seen separated, with their title and reporter name (or "anonymous" if this is flagged on that report).
expected_behaviors: I can know about issues in my area and beyond

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to choose whether to make my report anonymous 
So that my name is not shown in the public list of reports.
constraints: Anonymous option protects privacy. Choice made at issue description time.
expected_behaviors: my name is not shown in the public list of reports

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member
I want to see the list of reports assigned to me
So that I can get an overview of the maintenance to be done
expected_behaviors: I can get an overview of the maintenance to be done

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to configure my account
So that I can better manage notifications and my virtual presence.
constraints: Citizens can  upload a personal photo, add their Telegram username and switch off/on email notifications in the configuration panel.
expected_behaviors: I can better manage notifications and my virtual presence

requirements.text:
As a system administrator
I want to modify roles to municipality users
So that the staff can be more flexible.
constraints: This story overwrites a previous answer given by PO on the Telegram chat. NB: 1) A municipality user can now have multiple roles, i.e. serving on more than one technical office. 2) Modification includes cancellation.
expected_behaviors: the staff can be more flexible

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member 
I want to update report statuses 
So that citizens are informed of the problem resolution process.
constraints: At each status change, the citizen receives notification in the platform with the corresponding update. Municipal operators working on reports can also send messages to the citizens in the platform, to which the citizen can reply.
expected_behaviors: citizens are informed of the problem resolution process

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to reply to messages from municipal operators in the platform 
So that I can communicate directly about my report.
constraints: Two-way communication is possible within the platform.
expected_behaviors: I can communicate directly about my report

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to receive optional email alerts in addition to platform notifications 
So that I can choose the best way to stay updated.
constraints: Unless disabled in their configuration panel.
expected_behaviors: I can choose the best way to stay updated

requirements.text:
As a municipal administrator
I want to configure automatic assignment of all reports in a certain category
So that interventions will be faster.

As a citizen/unregistered user
I want to browse a summary table of reports with filters 
So that I can easily explore and analyze existing reports.
constraints: Filters: by category, status, period of time
expected_behaviors: I can easily explore and analyze existing reports

domain_rules: Reports must be in 'Pending Approval' state until the Organization Office performs preliminary verification.
Rejected reports require a mandatory explanation from the Municipality Organization Office.
Accepted reports move to 'Assigned' state and are sent to the competent technical office based on category.
Once intervention is scheduled, status changes to 'In Progress'.
When resolved, technical office updates status to 'Resolved' and closes the report.
Internal comments between technical office staff and external maintainers are not visible to citizens or reporters.
Automatic assignment of all issues of a certain category is possible only if previously set by the municipal administrator.
Only authenticated users (citizens) can view reports initially; from Sprint 4, unregistered users can also view reports.
An anonymous user's name is visible to staff but hidden in the public Turin map for citizens.
Once a report has been inserted, it cannot be modified or deleted by the citizen.
Public Relation officer can assign a report either to a specific technical office or directly to a staff member of that office.
Only technical office staff members can have multiple roles.
Notifications/messages can be set to either real-time or on page refresh depending on preference.
External maintainers are added by the system administrator and must have their own individual account (Case 1).
Communication between technical office and external maintainers without platform access is out of scope (Case 2).
Email is a mandatory field for registration and can be used for login.
Confirmation code for registration is valid for exactly 30 minutes.
Reports must be geolocated using OpenStreetMap standard layer.
edge_cases: User attempts to submit a report without registering: System blocks submission until registration and confirmation are complete.
User attempts to view reports before approval: System hides 'Pending Approval' reports from public view.
External maintainer resolves a report: System allows transition to 'Resolved' only if maintainer has access (Case 1).
Citizen tries to edit/delete their own report after submission: System denies action.
User zooms out on map significantly: System groups reports into cumulative view with total count.
User filters table by category and clicks download: System exports only the filtered subset as CSV.
Telegram bot receives command for non-existent report ID: System returns error or 'not found' message.
Citizen follows a report that is later resolved/rejected: System stops sending notifications once status becomes closed.
assumptions: The 'Organization Office' refers to the central administrative body responsible for initial review and rejection explanations.
Competent technical office mapping to categories is pre-configured in the system database.
Telegram bot integration requires a valid Telegram API connection and user authentication via username.
Push notifications rely on Telegram's native push mechanism or an integrated service.
The 'top 1%' and 'top 5%' statistics are calculated based on report volume per reporter over a specific time window (likely all time or configurable).
External maintainers without platform access (Case 2) communicate via external channels not tracked by Participium.
The map layer is strictly OpenStreetMap standard unless overridden by admin configuration.

risks: /sessions/current and /sessions/current DELETE share the same path but different methods; ensure client handles both correctly.
/reports/{id}/mainteiner has a typo in route name ('mainteiner' vs 'maintainer') which may cause confusion or misconfiguration.
Several endpoints return 423 (Locked) or 409 (Conflict); documentation does not specify exact conditions for these states.
Auto-assign endpoints rely on backend logic not visible in docs; failure modes are unclear.
Public endpoints (/upload-url, /reports/approved) lack explicit rate-limiting or abuse-mitigation notes.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Unregistered user can see approved reports on an interactive map.
strategy_items.prompt: Execute a GET request to /reports/approved without any authentication headers. Verify that the response contains a list of reports where status is 'Resolved' or equivalent approved states, and that no 'Pending Approval' reports are included.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the core requirement for public visibility of approved reports without authentication.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Unregistered user can see approved reports on an interactive map.
strategy_items.prompt: Execute a GET request to /reports/approved without authentication. Verify that the response excludes any reports currently in 'Pending Approval' state, ensuring only fully processed reports are visible.
strategy_items.rationale: Tests the filtering logic to ensure pending reports are hidden from unauthenticated users as per domain rules.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Unregistered user can see approved reports on an interactive map.
strategy_items.prompt: Execute a GET request to /reports/approved without authentication. Verify that the response returns a 401 Unauthorized status code if the endpoint is strictly protected and not public, or confirm that the system correctly handles unauthenticated access as defined in requirements.
strategy_items.rationale: Tests the boundary condition where unauthenticated access might be restricted despite the requirement implying visibility.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Municipal administrator can configure automatic assignment of all reports in a certain category.
strategy_items.prompt: Authenticate as a municipal administrator. Execute POST /reports/{id}/auto-assign-officer to assign a report automatically based on its category configuration. Verify that the assignment is successful and the report status changes appropriately.
setup_needed: POST /reports to create a new report resource with a specific category
POST /sessions to obtain an authenticated session for municipal_administrator
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: DELETE the created report via POST /reports/{id}/delete if it exists; otherwise, verify no resource was created.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the automatic assignment functionality configured by administrators.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Municipal public relations officer can review and approve or reject reports.
strategy_items.prompt: Authenticate as a municipal public relations officer. Execute PUT /reports/{id}/mainteiner to assign a report to an external maintainer for review. Verify that the assignment is successful and the report status reflects the new state.
setup_needed: POST /reports to create a new report resource
POST /sessions to obtain an authenticated session for municipal_public_relations_officer
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: DELETE the created report via POST /reports/{id}/delete if it exists; otherwise, verify no resource was created.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the ability of PR officers to assign reports for review.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Technical office staff member can assign reports to external maintainers.
strategy_items.prompt: Authenticate as a technical office staff member. Execute POST /reports/{id}/auto-assign-maintainer to automatically assign a report to an external maintainer based on category configuration. Verify that the assignment is successful and the report status changes appropriately.
setup_needed: POST /reports to create a new report resource with a specific category
POST /sessions to obtain an authenticated session for technical_office_staff
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: DELETE the created report via POST /reports/{id}/delete if it exists; otherwise, verify no resource was created.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the automatic assignment functionality configured by administrators.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: As a citizen I want to register with my name and username So that I can access the Participium system and submit reports.
strategy_items.prompt: Execute registration for a new citizen user. Provide valid name, unique username, and mandatory email address. Verify response indicates successful account creation or appropriate error if duplicate username/email is detected.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the entry point for user onboarding and ensures data integrity during initial account creation.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: As a citizen I want to confirm my registration with a code So that my account becomes valid and I can start using the system.
strategy_items.prompt: Simulate email verification flow. First, trigger code generation via /citizens/verification-code (authenticated). Then, call /citizens/verify-email with a valid 6-digit code within the 30-minute window. Verify account status updates to 'verified'.
setup_needed: POST /citizens/verification-code to generate a valid code
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
strategy_items.rationale: Ensures the critical account activation flow works correctly and respects the time-bound nature of verification codes.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: As an external maintainer I want to update the status of a report assigned to me So that I can updated citizens about the intervention.
strategy_items.prompt: Attempt to update the status of a report to 'Resolved' while acting as an external maintainer who does NOT have assignment access to this specific report. Verify the system denies the transition.
setup_needed: POST /reports to create a report assigned to a different user
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Verify no resource was created; delete it if unexpectedly present.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates role-based access control (RBAC) prevents unauthorized status changes.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: System administrator sets up municipality users.
strategy_items.prompt: Create a new municipality user with valid email, password, and role 'municipality_user'. Verify response includes created user ID and status 201.
setup_needed: Ensure session is active for admin role via /sessions/current
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates core user creation functionality required for subsequent role assignment and report management.
